Jyoti Prakash Patra

+91-7381551419 | jyotiprakash1405@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/jpatra | github.com/jyotiprakash1405

Summary

Senior Backend and Platform Engineer with 7+ years of experience building distributed, event-driven systems and LLM-powered platforms at production scale. At Maersk, architected an AI documentation assistant (DevPal) serving 18+ engineering teams using hybrid RAG, Azure OpenAI, and MCP — and independently owns a high-traffic survey platform built on Kafka, Temporal, and Node.js. Deep experience across the full delivery lifecycle: infra provisioning, schema design, CI/CD, LLM observability, and production migrations.

Experience

Senior Software Engineer Maersk InsightsHub — Enterprise Survey & Feedback Platform

Nov 2023 – Present Bangalore, India

Led end-to-end migration of a production survey platform from Java Spring Boot to Node.js (Fastify), reducing cold-start latency by ∼45% and cutting infrastructure costs by ∼30%.

Provisioned Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server via Terraform; owned CI/CD pipelines from build to production deployment.

Redesigned data schemas with Prisma ORM and executed zero-downtime large-scale production data migration with automated validation and rollback safeguards.

Integrated Kafka consumers to synchronize application and collaborator metadata with central systems, processing 10K+ events per day reliably.

Built Temporal workflows for survey scoring (NPS, CSAT, SUS), notifications, and collaboration updates — replacing fragile cron jobs and reducing failure-related incidents by ∼70%.

Implemented Redis caching layer supporting 1,000+ concurrent users with sub-50ms read latency, preventing DB saturation under peak load.

Created a dedicated orchestration service running Temporal workers, enabling horizontal scaling of async workloads independently from the API layer.

Set up Prometheus + Grafana dashboards tracking latency percentiles, error rates, and throughput; reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) issues by ∼50%.

Feature Suggestions Platform — Internal Product Feedback System

Designed and delivered a cross-team feature suggestion system serving multiple product teams, enabling structured product feedback at scale.

Modeled hierarchical discussions using self-referential Prisma relations, supporting arbitrarily nested comments and replies with O(1) lookup per node.

Implemented soft-delete strategies to preserve thread integrity and auditability across comment lifecycles. • Built engagement features (likes, emoji reactions, voting) and email notification workflows for comments, replies, and feature status transitions.

Designed a feature lifecycle integrated with Jira, enabling cross-team triage, scheduling, and release tracking from a single interface.

DevPal (DevEx Agent) — Enterprise LLM Developer Platform, 18+ Teams

Architected a multi-tenant AI documentation assistant in FastAPI + Azure OpenAI serving 18+ Maersk engineering teams, indexing 1,640+ documents and 1,107 GitHub discussions with 3072-dimension embeddings. • Designed a hybrid RAG pipeline: 3-pass LLM shuffle-and-tag ingestion strategy → Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merging tag-based search, vector similarity, and PostgreSQL full-text search — with LLM re-ranking via GPT-4.1-mini before answer generation via GPT-4.1.

Eliminated OpenAI Agents SDK overhead by replacing the gpt-4.1 routing agent with a direct gpt-4.1-mini structured output call — reducing P50 response time from 33–40s to 22–27s (∼35% faster) and streaming first token from 37s to 2–5s (10× improvement).

Reduced GitHub Discussions initial embedding sync from 55 minutes to ∼5 minutes by replacing sequential per-item API calls with batched embedding generation (100 texts/request).

Designed AI Ticket Triage service (TriageService): LLM completeness check → hybrid retrieval → confidence-gated auto-reply (threshold: 0.70) → Hedwig on-call escalation; integrated with MS Teams via Power Automate and GitHub Discussions webhooks; built bot-loop prevention via triage state machine.

• Built a platform tool registry auto-generated from OpenAPI specs (MDP, MTTS, MRMP, MAC, Stargate

APIs) enabling the LLM to fetch live platform data — activity logs, service state, Kafka topics, team rosters — without leaving the chat interface; user bearer token forwarded, no service principal needed.

Exposed an MCP server with Azure AD OAuth, enabling DevPal to be consumed as a tool in VS Code, Microsoft Teams, and Jira — adopted by 100+ engineers across the organization.

Built a 35-panel Grafana + Prometheus production observability stack; diagnosed and fixed 2 silent instrumentation bugs (fallback counter never incrementing, latency histogram using wrong label) that had been masking real metrics in prod.

Software Engineer HealthEdge Technologies

Jul 2022 – Oct 2023 Bangalore, India

Built a reusable React + Redux component library published as internal NPM packages, reducing UI development time across 3 product teams by ∼25%.

Developed backend REST APIs in Java Spring Boot with JWT-based authentication and role-based access control (RBAC).

Implemented BPMN-based process workflows using Kogito and managed schema versioning via Liquibase across multiple environments.

Software Developer Tata Consultancy Services

Feb 2019 – May 2022 Hyderabad, India

Developed and maintained REST APIs for enterprise SaaS applications serving 10,000+ users using Java and Spring Boot.

Wrote unit and integration tests achieving >80% code coverage on critical service modules. • Automated operational workflows using shell scripts, reducing manual release effort by ∼3 hours per deployment cycle.

Technical Skills

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL Backend: Node.js, Fastify, Express.js, FastAPI, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, SSE Streaming Distributed Systems: Apache Kafka, Temporal, Apache ActiveMQ, Apache Camel, Event-Driven Architecture Databases: PostgreSQL (tsvector, pgvector), Prisma ORM, Redis, Schema Design, Zero-Downtime Migrations Cloud & Infra: Azure, Azure OpenAI, Azure AD / OAuth 2.0, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Arize Phoenix (LLM Tracing), OpenTelemetry, SLO/SLA Monitoring AI / LLM: Hybrid RAG, RRF Retrieval, Vector Embeddings, Semantic Tagging, MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM Tool Use, Structured Output, Evals (Precision/Recall/F1) Testing: pytest, Jest, Integration Testing, TDD, LLM-as-Judge Evaluation

Education

Parala Maharaja Government Engineering College Bachelor of Technology, Mechanical Engineering

Odisha, India Aug 2014 – May 2018
